tierLists.hubLead: Rank anything, build a reusable template, or plan across several rows. Start locally with no account required.
tierLists.localLead: These lists stay in this browser. Export JSON to keep a copy or move them to another device.
tierLists.noLocalLists: Create or open a template to start your first list.
tierLists.presetEditorHint: Edit the base preset’s rows, rules, characters and starting assignments. Saving creates your own reusable copy on this device; the original preset stays available.
tierLists.startingPlacementsHint: Arrange the cards that every new list should start with. Reset list restores these assignments; Clear all placements empties the board. Changes to this preset’s defaults do not replace an existing list’s arrangement.
tierLists.startingReferenceHint: Starting assignments are preserved for this collection. Switch to custom items to edit them on the preview board.
tierLists.presetUpdated: This base preset has been updated. Create another list to use its current rows and starting assignments. Your saved arrangement is kept.
tierLists.title: Title
tierLists.headingHint: This title and optional description belong to this list. Your template and other lists keep their own headings. Visibility is controlled by the page and PNG switches.
tierLists.uploadSignIn: Use an image URL, or sign in to upload JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF images up to 5 MB.
tierLists.uploadPrivacy: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB. Uploaded images have public URLs, even when the list is private.
tierLists.editorError: Could not save. Check names, image URLs, file types and the 5 MB image limit, then try again.
tierLists.keepSourceVisible: Keep assigned items in the source pool

settings.allowRowEditing: Allow row label and color edits

tierLists.referenceHint: Items come from the existing site collection. Their stable IDs keep your assignments connected to the original entries.
tierLists.visibilityHint: This preference is saved with the template. All lists currently stay local; selecting public or unlisted does not publish them.
tierLists.exclusiveHint: Moving a card to another row removes its previous assignments.
tierLists.multiHint: A card can belong to multiple rows. Dropping into another row copies it; returning a card to available items removes only that placement.
tierLists.sourceCount: {count, plural, one {# item shown} other {# items shown}}
tierLists.emptyPool: No available items. Move items back here or edit the template to add more.
tierLists.emptyRow: Drop items here or tap an item to assign it
tierLists.confirmBody: This removes the selected items, rows or assignments. Board changes can be undone while this page stays open.
tierLists.applyTemplateBody: Existing assignments will be kept where possible. Deleted items or rows and changes to placement rules may remove assignments.

display.heading: Page and PNG appearance
display.hint: These switches change both the page and PNG. Counts are optional. Edit the list heading from the toolbar and row names from their gear menu.
display.title: Title

tierLists.imageError: Could not export the image. Very large boards or external images that block downloading cannot be captured. Try an uploaded image or another image URL.
tierLists.fileError: Could not process the file. Imports must be valid version 1 tier-list JSON under 5 MB. Very large boards may exceed the PNG size limit.
tierLists.hubError: Could not read local storage or import this file. Use a valid version 1 tier-list JSON file under 5 MB.
tierLists.invalidLocal: {count, plural, one {# unreadable local list was preserved.} other {# unreadable local lists were preserved.}}
tierLists.sourceError: Could not load this collection. Check your connection and try again.
tierLists.storageLoadError: Could not read the saved list. The existing data has been kept.
tierLists.localMissing: This local list is not available in this browser. Import its JSON file or start a new template.
tierLists.recoverBody: This deletes the unreadable saved document on this device and starts again. Export or back up your browser data first if you need that document.
tierLists.newInstanceError: Could not save the new list. Your current list has been kept.
tierLists.deleteListBody: This removes this saved list from this browser. Other lists and the original system template are kept.

status.error: Save failed. Your changes are still on this page; retry or export a copy.

tierLists.dragHint: Drag anywhere on a card; the highlighted slot previews its position before you drop. Tap or press Enter to choose a row; on touch screens, hold briefly to drag.
tierLists.dragInstructions: Focus a card and press Space to pick it up, use arrow keys to move it, and press Space to drop or Escape to cancel. Tap or press Enter to choose a row.
tierLists.dragOver: Choose a row or an item position.

standard.title: Classic S / A / B / C
standard.description: A classic exclusive ranking. Remix it with your own items.

planner.title: Multi-row planner
planner.description: Assign the same item to several groups while keeping the source pool available.

games.title: Site game collection
games.description: Rank games from the existing Boffmedia catalog using their original entries.

fortunesWeave.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave
fortunesWeave.description: Plan the 50 characters across Cai, Dietrich, Theodora and Leda’s routes. Each lord starts in their own group, and a character can join several routes. Uses pre-timeskip portraits.
